profile_text.body:
Writer is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an enterprise AI agent platform trusted by Fortune 500 companies, built to help teams execute and scale on-brand, compliant work. Its site emphasizes a five-year track record of AI research and large language model innovation, with a stated focus on transparency, reliability, and control for enterprise customers.

The company's primary product is Writer.com, an enterprise writing AI platform that encompasses brand governance, style guide enforcement, hallucination detection, and its proprietary PALMYRA models. The platform supports agentic workflows and is positioned toward use cases in enterprise marketing, including pipeline generation and brand integrity management for Global 2000 organizations. Writer also offers certifications, self-paced courses, and video tutorials covering generative AI fundamentals and custom AI agent development.

The held facts note that Writer has an associated MCP server entry for DocuWriter.ai, a tool described as offering 72 tools including an Autopilot feature for generating, searching, and managing codebase documentation. No litigation cases are on record for the company, though its law exposure data is indexed to California, consistent with its San Francisco headquarters.
